limits: Diagnostic profiled windows; not unprofiled latency/throughput measurements.
Eight automatic-stop worker iterations; RECORD warning means only complete exported X ranges are analyzed.
Host scopes are inclusive/nested; do not add them or treat Event synchronize as removable overhead.
Device compute excludes Communication track and recognized HCCL; active fraction is window coverage, not core occupancy.
Native and plugin can have different actual forward/replay counts despite the same client requests and iteration limit.
Client tail stall across automatic profiler stop is excluded from device-kernel span and is not an inference regression.
